cases.explain: «древней межи» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

cases.explain: «глубокая яма» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
